contactInfoHelp: This tenant's name and how to reach it.
title: Settings
subtitle: System configuration for this tenant. User-scoped overrides win over tenant values, which in turn win over global defaults.
featuresSubtitleAdmin: Enable or disable features globally. Tenant-specific overrides are shown per flag.
featuresSubtitleTenant: View and manage features for your organization. Platform features can be opted out.
tenantFeaturesSubtitle: Choose which per-tenant features this tenant uses. A change takes effect straight away.
tenantFeatureError: The change could not be saved. Reload the page and try again.
tenantFlagHelp_FF_DIRECTORY: Managers and focal persons of this tenant can open the Directory section.
tenantFlagHelp_FF_PUBLIC_DIRECTORY: This tenant's approved people appear in the directory search.
tenantFlagHelp_FF_NOTIFICATIONS: Users of this tenant see the notification bell and inbox, where submissions, approvals and rejections are announced.
businessHoursSubtitle: Define when your tenant is open. Used to anchor SLA pause windows and scheduling.
tenantInitialUserHelp: Optionally move a user who belongs to no tenant into this tenant as its first focal person or manager. Leave empty to create the tenant with no members; you can assign users later from the user edit form.
tenantInitialUserEmpty: No users without a tenant are available. Create a user first, or leave this empty and assign someone later.
tenantInitialUserRoleHelp_focal: Registers records and submits them for review
tenantInitialUserRoleHelp_manager: Approves submissions and edits records directly
